description: Enter the STRONG door on the car's RIGHT, then drive 2 m straight on to come out the other side. TWO MOVES BECAUSE 'entered' MEANS STANDING IN THE OPENING: enter_door's arrival test is the midpoint between the jambs with the car pointing through (DoorSpec, WHAT "ENTERED" MEANS), deliberately not the far side of the wall, so a command that asks to go THROUGH a doorway and on into the room needs this second move. The second move is a plain open-ended drive holding the heading it starts with -- which, after the first move, is the door's own crossing direction -- for 2 m measured from where the first move ended.
